skills.name: Destined Demise
skills.description:
Passive: At the start of battle, selects the enemy in the opposite position and inflicts the "Destined Demise" state (Destined Demise: Takes an additional 5% True DMG when taking DMG).
Active: Deals DMG equal to 700% ATK to the nearest enemy, reduces the target's Max HP by 100% ATK, and deals additional DMG equal to 10% of the target's lost HP. This skill prioritizes enemies in the "Destined Demise" state.

upgrades.level3: Deals additional DMG equal to 15% of the target's lost HP.

skills.name: Fateweaving
skills.description:
Enters the "Weaving" state, increasing the DMG of the subsequent dash by 100% ATK per second.
Dashes toward the unit with "Destined Demise" when their HP drops to 50% or when "Weaving" lasts for 12 seconds, dealing DMG equal to 300% ATK.

upgrades.level2: In the "Weaving" state, increases the DMG of the subsequent dash by 130% ATK per second.
upgrades.level4: In the "Weaving" state, increases the DMG of the subsequent dash by 160% ATK per second.

skills.name: Unseen Destiny
skills.description: If Ananke takes no DMG for 5 seconds, she enters the Untargetable state. This state is canceled after Ananke launches an ATK.

upgrades.level2: If Ananke takes no DMG for 4 seconds, she enters the Untargetable state.
upgrades.level3: If Ananke takes no DMG for 3 seconds, she enters the Untargetable state.
upgrades.level4: Every time Ananke participates in a kill, she immediately enters this state.

skills.name: Threads of Fate
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 300% ATK to enemies within a 3-meter AoE, and increases DMG dealt to units with "Destined Demise" by an additional 200% ATK.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to units with "Destined Demise" by an additional 300% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Deals DMG equal to 400% ATK to enemies within a 3-meter AoE.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to units with "Destined Demise" by an additional 400% ATK.

relic.name: Absolute Necessity
relic.description: When a target with "Destined Demise" takes DMG, they take an additional 10% True DMG.

upgrades.level2: When a unit with "Destined Demise" dies, immediately marks the enemy with the highest ATK with "Destined Demise".
upgrades.level3: When a target with "Destined Demise" takes DMG, they take an additional 20% True DMG.
upgrades.level4: After participating in killing an enemy with "Destined Demise", Ananke immediately triggers a [Fateweaving] dash toward the next enemy with "Destined Demise".
